business.body:
- Established in 1986 and publicly listed in 1993, described as one of the leading players in rigid plastic packaging in India, with 40+ years of experience.
- Pioneers in the field of In-Mold labelling (IML) in India: HD photographic labels produced by 100% hands-free operation and 100% recyclable.
- Deck states MTPL commands strong presence across all major customers like Asian Paints, Castrol, Shell, Mondelez and Hindustan Unilever.
- Frames itself as 'Future-Ready @ 40' - Agile, Innovation-Driven, Customer Focused, Sustainable - with 'Nimble & Responsive', 'Gen Z relevance', 'Sustainability Focus' and 'Modern Trade Ready' as its four pillars.
- Awards cited: Asia's Best Company under a Billion 2023, Best Packaging Company Award thrice in a row, 3 India Star Awards, and Best SME and Tech Savvy Award.

business.body: - [In-house capability chain] The deck presents an end-to-end in-house flow - conceptualizing, rapid prototyping, label printing, pilot development and commercial mold development - supported by a modern tool room, design studio, label making and self-developed robots.

themes.title: Specialty packaging & sustainable materials
themes.need: Premiumization, e-commerce and a sustainability/recycling mandate drive a packaging up-cycle across flexible films, rigid plastics, cartons and compostables. UFLEX/EPL/HUHTAMAKI/COSMOFIRST/ESTER on films/tubes; TCPLPACK/AGI/BOROLTD on cartons/glass; MOLDTKPAC/MOLDTECH on rigid/IML; PAKKA/GANECOS on compostable & recycled materials.
themes.driver: Brand-owner restocking; export demand recovery; recycled-content mandates; commodity-cost pass-through.
